report.title: Pinning memos in the "Explore section" not working
report.body:
### Describe the bug

Pinning a memo in your personal area works just fine, however when pinning a memo in the explore section (e.g. a protected post) it has no effect.

### Steps to reproduce

create two posts, pin the older one in the explore section. Pinning it has no effect.

### The version of Memos you're using


0.25 (canary)

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_

preconditions: two memos exist, the older one and a newer one
the Explore section lists the memos
steps: Type "older memo" into the memo editor on the home page
Click the Save button to create the first memo
Type "newer memo" into the memo editor
Click the Save button to create the second memo
Open the Explore section from the navigation
Open the menu on the "older memo" entry in the Explore list
plan.expected: After pinning, the "older memo" entry appears at the top of the Explore list above "newer memo" and is marked as pinned.
plan.reported_actual: Pinning a memo in the Explore section has no effect; the memo is not pinned and the order does not change.
missing: Does the Pin option appear in the memo menu in Explore for the reporter, and for which memo visibility (public, protected)?
What visibility were the two posts created with?
assumed: memos are created with default visibility and the content "older memo" and "newer memo" since the reporter gave no content
assumed: pinned memos are expected to move to the top of the Explore list
assumed: the menu is a three-dot or similar menu on the memo card
plan.summary: Pinning a memo from the Explore section has no effect, while pinning in the personal area works

# Pinning memos in the "Explore section" not working

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:16217/.
Stay on localhost:16217 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Type "older memo" into the memo editor on the home page
2. Click the Save button to create the first memo
3. Type "newer memo" into the memo editor
4. Click the Save button to create the second memo
5. Open the Explore section from the navigation
6. Open the menu on the "older memo" entry in the Explore list
7. Click Pin in the menu
The reporter says the correct behavior is that After pinning, the "older memo" entry appears at the top of the Explore list above "newer memo" and is marked as pinned. Verify that After pinning, the "older memo" entry appears at the top of the Explore list above "newer memo" and is marked as pinned.

verdict.headline: Kane saw a mismatch at the final check but judged it a problem with the steps or the expectation, not the app. The report may be missing detail.
verdict.stuck_at: The Explore page displays “No data found,” so no older memo entry or menu is available.

run.reason: The Explore page displays “No data found,” so no older memo entry or menu is available.
run.summary:
Both memos were saved with the composer set to Private. The run then assumed those private items would appear in the Explore list, so there was no older memo entry available to pin.
Update the test setup to create memos with the visibility required by Explore, or change the expected destination to the private memo list before testing pinning.
